guillemins.name: Liège-Guillemins Station
guillemins.slogan: A white steel wave over the tracks.
guillemins.line: Santiago Calatrava's station opened in 2009 under a glass-and-steel arch 160 metres long and 32 metres high.

bueren.name: Montagne de Bueren
bueren.slogan: 374 steps up to the best view over the Meuse.
bueren.line: Built in 1881, the stairway honours 600 soldiers who died defending Liège against Charles the Bold's Burgundians.

perron.name: Le Perron
perron.slogan: The column Liège never stopped believing in.
perron.line: After the 1468 uprising Charles the Bold had the Perron carried off to Bruges; it came back about ten years later.

spa.name: Spa
spa.slogan: Where every bathhouse in the world got its name.
spa.line: Spa has more than 300 cold mineral springs, and its pouhon waters are far older than the rain that feeds the lighter ones.

grandcurtius.name: Grand Curtius
grandcurtius.slogan: An arms dealer's red-brick palace full of Liège's treasures.
grandcurtius.line: Its core is the mansion built around 1600 for Jean Curtius, who grew rich supplying gunpowder to Spain's armies.
